s=s[:a]+'''def topology(data, ixps):
    aggregated = {}
    for record in data['rib']:
        path = clean(record['path'], ixps)
        if len(path) >= 2 and len(set(path)) == len(path):
            aggregated[path] = aggregated.get(path, 0) + record['count']

    # Track the number of paths witnessing that each endpoint is INTERNAL.
    # A link is peripheral iff one of these two counters is zero. Keeping
    # coincident trimmed paths separate is equivalent to aggregating them:
    # multiplicity changes a positive counter but never whether it is zero.
    edge_index, edges = {}, []
    occurrences, live, bad_u, bad_v = [], [], [], []
    paths, path_edges, counts = [], [], []
    for pid, (path, count) in enumerate(aggregated.items()):
        paths.append(path)
        counts.append(count)
        es = []
        first, last = path[0], path[-1]
        for a, b in zip(path, path[1:]):
            edge = canonical(a, b)
            eid = edge_index.get(edge)
            if eid is None:
                eid = len(edges)
                edge_index[edge] = eid
                edges.append(edge)
                occurrences.append([])
                live.append(0)
                bad_u.append(0)
                bad_v.append(0)
            u, v = edge
            occurrences[eid].append(pid)
            live[eid] += 1
            bad_u[eid] += int(u != first and u != last)
            bad_v[eid] += int(v != first and v != last)
            es.append(eid)
        path_edges.append(es)
    require(len(edges) <= 4096)
    starts = [0] * len(paths)
    ends = [len(p) for p in paths]
    rounds = [0] * len(edges)
    marked = {e for e in range(len(edges)) if bad_u[e] == 0 or bad_v[e] == 0}
    r = 1
    while marked:
        affected = set()
        for eid in marked:
            rounds[eid] = r
            affected.update(occurrences[eid])
        changed = set()
        for pid in affected:
            start, end = starts[pid], ends[pid]
            if end - start < 2:
                continue
            es, path = path_edges[pid], paths[pid]
            left = int(es[start] in marked)
            right = int(es[end - 2] in marked)
            if not left and not right:
                continue
            ns, ne = start + left, end - right
            candidates = {start, end - 2}
            remains = ne - ns >= 2
            if remains:
                candidates.update((ns, ne - 2))
            old_first, old_last = path[start], path[end - 1]
            for j in candidates:
                eid = es[j]
                u, v = edges[eid]
                # Only old/new boundary links can change their contribution.
                bad_u[eid] -= int(u != old_first and u != old_last)
                bad_v[eid] -= int(v != old_first and v != old_last)
                if remains and ns <= j < ne - 1:
                    bad_u[eid] += int(u != path[ns] and u != path[ne - 1])
                    bad_v[eid] += int(v != path[ns] and v != path[ne - 1])
                else:
                    live[eid] -= 1
                changed.add(eid)
            starts[pid], ends[pid] = ns, ne
        # Decide the NEXT simultaneous round only after every trim is applied.
        marked = {e for e in changed if rounds[e] == 0 and live[e] > 0
                  and (bad_u[e] == 0 or bad_v[e] == 0)}
        r += 1
    final_paths = {}
    for path, start, end, count in zip(paths, starts, ends, counts):
        if end - start >= 2:
            p = path[start:end]
            final_paths[p] = final_paths.get(p, 0) + count
    return final_paths, dict(zip(edges, rounds))
''' +s[b:]
